title: SITAM KE DASHT ME ZEHRA KA LAAL TANHA HAI
body:
Pisar ke qalb me naiza laga jo dekha hai
Gaya hai Noore Nazar har taraf andhera hai
Kamar khameeda hai seene me dard uthta hai
Zaeef Baap hai aur Naojawa'n ka Laasha hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahan ho khulq ke Mushkil Kusha duhaai hai
Ajal jawaan ko dashte bala me laayi hai
Wo bebasi hai ke ansaar hain na Bhai hai
Madad ka waqt hai Shabbir be sahara hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jawa'n ke qalb me tooti hui hai noke sina
Zami'n pa paau'n ragadte hain Akbare Zeesha'n
Pidar ke Dil me machalta hai dard ka toofa'n
Nazar ke saamne Bete ka dam nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sambhaale haatho'n se dil ko tadap raha hai Pisar
Rakhe hain haath Rasoolo'n ne Apni aankhon par
Hussain dekh rahe hain ye hashr ka manzar
YeDil Hussain ka hai ye jigar Hussain ka hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pidar ka Noore Nazar Maa ka hasrato'n waala
Hai khaako khoon me ghaltaa'n wo gesuo'n waala
Jaha'n se hogaya rukhsat wo mannato'n waala
Usi ki raah me khaime ke dar pa Laila hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pisar ki maut pa jo beqarar Bhai hai
To besukoon idhar Fatima ki Jaayi hai
Madad ko Shah ki khaime se baahar aayi hai
Na hosh parde ka hai aur na khaufe aada hai
<<MINI>>
Sitam ke dasht me Zehra ka LaalTanha hai
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
